name: AirForge
tagline: Draw ramps, balls, platforms, and curves; Rapier simulates them in 2.5D.
description: Browser-based 2.5D sketch-to-physics playground with mouse drawing, curved tracks, motion marks, optional webcam gestures, and scene files and links.
summary: A browser physics sandbox: drawn strokes become ramps, balls, platforms, and curved tracks that Rapier simulates at a fixed 120 Hz.

lead.caption: Drawing a ramp, a ball, and a platform with the mouse, then Drop: the ball rolls off the ramp and lands on the platform.
lead.alt: Screen recording of AirForge on a gridded sheet: a drawn line becomes a black ramp, a small circle becomes a ball, a long rectangle becomes a platform, and after Drop the blue ball rolls down the ramp, flies off its end, and lands on the platform.
